findings.text: The census misses a live creator in scope: `Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js:207-210` `voice_session()` mkdirs `sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cloud-voice-<name>/` and writes its own line 1 by hand, never asking SessionFolders. Add it as a row in `census.md` (the counts become 4 + 4 = 8), and list it under "Not on it, on purpose" in `sessions/doc/one-folder.md` (same reason as the `v-…` voice sessions: not a uuid id), or move it onto `create(id, {dir, first})`.

`census.md` reads as today's state, but the build has since moved five of its rows onto `SessionFolders#create`, and `one-folder.md:183` links it as "the census that found the creators". Add one line at its top: "a snapshot from before the build (7097d66e1); after it, every row except Sessions.js, RemoteMCP.js and TaskDirs calls `create`". Without that line, a fresh agent will take the reply-relay and open_task rows as still open.

The task folder doesn't say where the build stands. `session.jsonl` ends at the census log and a heartbeat; nothing records that the build is on `worktree/qf-1` (7097d66e1), that it is not merged yet, or that the spawn tests were never run. Append one `log` line saying so, so the next agent knows to merge it and to run the spawn path (an `open_task` smoke test on the main tree, which has the SDK).

`Servex/agents/Agents.js:1126`: the `claim` used to sit inside its own try/catch that only warned. Now it runs inside `create`, so if `claim`'s `save()` throws, the whole `spawn_agent` fails. Wrapping that one call again would keep a cache-write failure from blocking a spawn.

`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:144`: an existing folder that has only a `page.jsonl` (older sessions) now gets a new `session.jsonl` with `kind: "agent"` on its next own-page write, even when it is the owner's tab session. This doesn't make a twin, but the kind may be wrong. Consider passing `first` only when the folder is new.

Stale comments and imports: `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:76` still says "AISession.locate() makes one"; `.claude/hooks/session-page.mjs:4` still imports `SessionRecord`, which nothing there uses now; `public/framework/ai/design-decisions-2026-10-27.md:63` lists the old creators (it is a dated doc, so a one-line pointer to `one-folder.md` "The one creator" is enough).

I checked these on the worktree, and they hold: `SessionFolders.test.mjs` passes its 33 checks, `page_tools.test.mjs` passes its 44, and all three hooks pass `node --check`. The `reply-relay.mjs` fix is real (it used `os` with no import, and it wrote outside the store). `claim()` returns false and does not throw for a folder directly under a day, so `open_task` on a top-level session folder is safe.
